name: Forward Data Set Submission Report V 05
definition: Scope|The ForwardDataSetSubmissionReport message is sent by the matching application to the counterparty(ies) of the submitter of data sets.|This message is used to pass on information related to the purchasing agreement(s) covered by the transaction(s) referred to in the message.|Usage|The ForwardDataSetSubmission message can be sent by the matching application to forward the details of a DataSetSubmission message that it has obtained.

RelatedTransactionReferences.name: Related Transaction References
RelatedTransactionReferences.definition: Identifies the transactions that this submission relates to and provides associated information.

CommonSubmissionReference.name: Common Submission Reference
CommonSubmissionReference.definition: This reference must be used for all data sets belonging to the same submission group.

Submitter.name: Submitter
Submitter.definition: The financial institution that has submitted the data sets to the matching engine.

BuyerBank.name: Buyer Bank
BuyerBank.definition: The financial institution of the buyer, uniquely identified by its BIC.

SellerBank.name: Seller Bank
SellerBank.definition: The financial institution of the seller, uniquely identified by its BIC.

CommercialDataSet.name: Commercial Data Set
CommercialDataSet.definition: Commercial information that has been submitted to the matching application by the other party.

TransportDataSet.name: Transport Data Set
TransportDataSet.definition: Transport information that has been submitted to the matching application by the other party.

InsuranceDataSet.name: Insurance Data Set
InsuranceDataSet.definition: Insurance information that has been submitted to the matching application by the other party.

CertificateDataSet.name: Certificate Data Set
CertificateDataSet.definition: Certificate information that has been submitted to the matching application by the other party.

OtherCertificateDataSet.name: Other Certificate Data Set
OtherCertificateDataSet.definition: Other certificate information that has been submitted to the matching application by the other party.
